Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.hud

Class NotificationService

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.scenemanager.utils.hud.NotificationService
public final class NotificationService extends Object
The native 3D desktop's notification entry point.

This is the desktop-agnostic seam that reuses the pure notification models the 2D/Swing desktop already ships (NotificationModel log, ToastQueue transient popups and DoNotDisturb gate — all now public so both shells share one implementation) and exposes them to the 3D desktop. Anything running in the desktop JVM posts through get().post(...); the HUD toast overlay (ToastOverlayPlugin in lg3d-widgets) subscribes with addListener(Runnable) and renders visibleToasts() on the front-most DesktopHudLayer.

Posting always records the notification in the log (so history/unread stay complete) but only raises a toast when Do Not Disturb does not suppress its Notification.Kind; Notification.Kind.ERROR always surfaces. All time is read through an injectable LongSupplier clock, so the whole service is deterministic and unit-testable headless.

notify(String, String, Notification.Kind) is the unified app-facing entry point: it routes to the running desktop shell — the 2D desktop's taskbar tray and toast layer (Desktop2D.postNotification(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.Notification.Kind)) when one is up, this service otherwise — so one call site (Mail's new-mail toast, the messenger's incoming-chat toast) works on both desktops.

  • Method Details

    • get

      public static NotificationService get()

    • notify

      public static void notify(String title, String message, Notification.Kind kind)
      Raises a desktop notification on whichever shell is running, the one entry point desktop apps use for their incoming-event toasts. Routes to the 2D desktop (Desktop2D.postNotification(java.lang.String, java.lang.String, org.jdesktop.lg3d.displayserver.desktop2d.Notification.Kind): toast layer plus taskbar tray log, Do-Not-Disturb gated there) when a 2D shell is up in this JVM, and to the process-wide 3D HUD service otherwise. Safe to call from any thread; the surfaces marshal to their own threads.

    • post

      public Notification post(String title, String message, Notification.Kind kind)
      Records a notification and, unless Do Not Disturb suppresses its kind, raises it as a transient toast. Notifies listeners either way (the log changed).
      Parameters:
      title - the short heading; must be non-blank
      message - the optional body (may be null/blank)
      kind - the severity; null is treated as Notification.Kind.INFO
      Returns:
      the logged notification
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if title is null or blank
